verdict.rationale: Airbyte documents an official open-source CLI, abctl, but its scope is limited to creating and managing local Airbyte instances in Docker. There is no evidence it can manage connections or syncs, or that it is designed for AI-native or agent workflows. PyAirbyte, the API and Terraform are separate programmatic interfaces, not a CLI. Missing for 10: CLI coverage of pipeline and connection operations, AI-native/agent-oriented CLI features, and independent or hands-on corroboration of CLI use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: abctl is Airbyte's open source command line tool to create and manage local instances of Airbyte running in Docker.
abctl makes it easy to run Airbyte anywhere Docker is running.
